gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the role a rigid inclusion column plays in the works, as distinct from what it is made of or how it is built - trial, test, production, or sacrificial. Shared by the as-built record (diggs:RIColumn/elementClass) and the planned record (diggs:TargetRIColumn/elementClass) so design-stage and as-built statements of an element's role do not drift into different vocabularies for the same concept. Both host elements are mandatory: the distinction governs which acceptance criteria apply and how a test result may be extrapolated, so it must be stated rather than inferred - superseding the earlier convention of inferring a trial column from the absence of diggs:RIColumnType/samplingFeatureRef, which remains valid as description but is no longer the identifying signal.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Rigid Inclusion Element Class Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An element installed before production begins, to prove the installation method or calibrate the design. Normally not part of the permanent works. Constructed independently of any rigid inclusion system by definition - diggs:RIColumnType/samplingFeatureRef is correspondingly irrelevant for a trial element, not merely omitted, since there is no parent system for it to cite.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Trial

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A production element selected for verification testing. Distinct from a trial element (which precedes and is independent of production) and from a sacrificial element (which is destroyed by the test): a test element is a permanent, in-service element that also happens to be tested, and is expected to remain in service afterward.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Test

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An element that carries permanent load and is not tested destructively. The default, unremarkable case - most elements in a rigid inclusion system are production elements.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Production

diggs:Definition.gml:description: An element installed specifically to be tested to failure, and not relied on to carry permanent load either during or after the test.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Sacrificial
